# EPIC-01: Alpha

---

> Alpha is the foundation: open a project and see what it contains.

**Stories:** US-0101, US-0102

**Status (2026-11-13):** 🚧 Built, not released.

---

## User Stories

**US-0101: Open a project** ✅ Done
- As a **developer**, in order to **see my work**, I would like to **open a project folder**.
- **Epic:** EPIC-01
- **Priority:** High
- **Complexity:** Low
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [x] **Given** a folder, **when** I open it, **then** it is shown in a tab
  - [x] **Given** an open tab, **when** I close it, **then** it disappears
- **Dependencies:** None

**US-0102: Show the project contents** 🚧 Built, not released
- As a **product owner**, in order to **follow the work**, I would like to **see the contents of the project**.
- **Epic:** EPIC-01
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Complexity:** Medium
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [x] The contents are listed
  - [ ] The list updates live
  - [ ] Empty folders show a message
- **Notes:** Read-only.
- **Dependencies:** US-0101
